result.reason: The grant appropriately covers affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to an M&A successor, but section 2(c) still ends the licence whenever the Agreement is terminated under section 12. Thus, the operative language does not ensure that a subscription licence is terminable only for uncured material breach or that any paid-up licence is perpetual and irrevocable. Adding correspondent broker customers exceeds the supplied playbook position and materially broadens the user population. The revocability language also conflicts with the unchanged term provision, and the clause retains an incomplete trailing phrase ('so long as such'), so it is not professionally complete.
